definitions.gloss: to spoil; to pamper; to indulge someone too much
definitions.explanation: To be overly lenient or indulgent with someone, especially a child, often with negative implications of producing bad behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘|あま}やかし⟦すぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: It's not good to spoil children too much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘|あま}やかす⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Grandparents tend to spoil their grandchildren.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{甘|あま}やかされて⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。

⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦といって→と：00512_to⟧{甘|あま}やかして⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦わがまま→わがまま：03789_wagamama⟧な⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you keep spoiling them just because they're cute, they'll turn into a selfish child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘|あま}やかし⟦すぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: As a result of the parents spoiling the child too much, they grew into an adult who can't do anything on their own.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
・Type: transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
・Pair: ⟦{甘|あま}える→甘える：06624_amaeru⟧ (to act spoiled, to seek indulgence) - intransitive
・Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧Y⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘|あま}やかす - the person being indulged is the object

ASPECT:
・{甘|あま}やかしている = is spoiling (an action in progress, or a habit)
・{甘|あま}やかされて⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧ = to grow up spoiled - the passive plus a verb of growing is the usual way to say this about a person

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘|あま}やかす (to spoil a child)
・{甘|あま}やかして⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ (to raise someone indulgently)
・{甘|あま}やかし⟦すぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (to be too lenient)

NUANCE:
Unlike simple kindness, {甘|あま}やかす implies leniency that goes too far, and it is nearly always used with disapproval - it points at a failure to set limits. The word usually paired against it is ⟦しつけ→躾：10342_shitsuke⟧ (discipline, bringing a child up properly).
